  - type: rich-text

    heading: Finding the studio
    text: |-
      We are on the ground floor of the old tannery, at the end of the cobbled yard behind the market hall. The entrance is step-free and there is a bench outside if you are early.

      - **By train** — two minutes from Ashcombe station; leave by the market exit.
      - **By bike** — racks in the yard, and a hose if you have come along the towpath.
      - **By car** — the Mill Lane car park is the closest, about five minutes' walk.
